parties: ARG 8583 - T Verde - Diego Peisajovich Felipao Caivano
procedural_matters: Heiko Thoelmann represented the IJ in the protest.
ARG 8583 was represented by Diego Peisajovich Felipao.
Lucia Ranza attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Mark 1 at the end of the first beat to windward of race 2.
ARG 8583 on starboard tack was sailing close-hauled course heading to the mark.
ARG 8583 touched mark 1 with her port side of the hull.
ARG 8583 did not take a penalty turn.
conclusions: ARG 8583 touched mark 1 and broke RRS 31.
